description: This file contains a class 'EndpointOptionsProvider' responsible for configuring 'EndpointOptions', specifically setting the IP address used for endpoint advertisement. It implements post-configuration logic including resolving the IP address and logging warnings or errors if resolution fails.

classes.name: EndpointOptionsProvider
classes.description: A provider class that implements post-configuration logic for EndpointOptions, mainly managing the advertised IP address.

methods.name: PostConfigure
methods.description: After initial configuration, ensures that the 'AdvertisedIPAddress' property is set, resolving it if null, and handling errors during resolution.
